name: Master Imbuer
body:
When you use your special torch ability to imbue a weapon with the torch’s power, the weapon remains imbued for much longer.

Prerequisite(s): Any pyro special torch attack class feature that can be used to imbue a weapon (e.g., blazing torch, sparking torch, thundering torch, witchfire torch, etc.), base attack bonus +2.

Benefit(s): When you use one of your special torches to imbue a weapon with its power, the duration of the imbuement is doubled. For example, when a 4th level pyro with this feat uses a blazing torch to imbue a weapon with the flaming ability, the weapon remains flaming for four minutes, instead of two minutes. Normally, a weapon remains imbued for only one minute per two pyro levels. In addition, you can now use a swift action to imbue a weapon. Normally, imbuing a weapon requires a standard action.
